polityNote: Mauritius from independence (1968-03-12). First-level divisions: the nine districts of Mauritius island, Rodrigues (dependency, then island region) and the dependencies Agaléga and Cargados Carajos (St. Brandon), as in ISO 3166-2:MU and statoids. The Chagos Archipelago had been detached on 1965-11-08 (British Indian Ocean Territory) and is not part of this dossier. Local-government councils (three district councils and five urban councils in 1971, per statoids) are a different, non-territorial layer and are not drawn. Atoms are geoBoundaries MUS ADM1 (OpenStreetMap, ODbL). Independent check (①): atom areas vs statoids — every district of Mauritius island within 4% (Black River 257 vs 259 km², Flacq 298 vs 298, Moka 236 vs 231, Savanne 249 vs 243) except Port Louis 40.5 vs 44 (−8%); Rodrigues 109 vs 104.
